one_month_reasoning: Q3 FY26 results are most likely Wed 2026-10-28 (FORM has reported on a Wednesday every recent quarter; supervisor verified via EDGAR 8-K dates), inside the window. Industry read-throughs remain strong (Micron FQ4 and FQ1 guide [4]; Technoprobe and Advantest raised outlooks [5][7]; TSMC Q3 mid-Oct is a further read), so a revenue beat versus the $270M guide is likely. But the Q3 $0.86/54% GM guide includes ~300bp of one-off margin (tariff refunds of $7-9M per the 10-Q [2], plus metal reclaims [14]), so the Q4 margin guide should step down toward ~51% as those drop out and Farmers Branch costs start; after a ~55% one-month run on a single sell-side note [11], that offsets beat momentum. Centre at ~$147.5 (just under spot; actual 10/2 close $149.15 per [19]) with a one-month sigma of ~20-21% including the earnings gap, slightly fatter on the downside.

reasoning: Round 2. Supervisor established (with 10-Q evidence) that the Q3 guide carries ~300bp of one-off margin, so clean EPS run rate is ~$0.77/qtr (~$3.10 annualized), not $3.45; I accept this and rebuilt EPS to ~$4.25 NTM at Oct 2027. I also correct the Technoprobe guide to EUR1.05-1.10bn / 46-48% EBITDA (confirmed by refetching Teleborsa [5]), relabel the $4.25 FY28 / 40x figure as a Seeking Alpha contributor note [13], and project net cash explicitly ($5.7 by Oct 2027). Industry follow-up on HBM4 share: FORM remains the main HBM probe supplier to the top three memory makers, with HBM ~2/3 of DRAM revenue and DRAM probe +70% y/y in Q1 [16]; HBM4 16-high stacks and doubled pin count raise test intensity and wear [15]; Samsung and SK hynix both qualified for Nvidia Rubin HBM4 [18]. Against that, Technoprobe's growth is in logic/AI where TrendForce has it overtaking FORM [9], and Korean vendors have been qualifying HBM probe cards at SK hynix [17] (2024 report; no 2026 evidence of material share loss found). Net: demand is strong, share is mixed (stable-to-strong in HBM, losing in logic), which I reflect in a lower multiple (30x, 7.8x sales). Fair value ~$136 vs $149 spot: base case slightly down. Distribution: median ~$140, lognormal sigma ~0.55 upside / 0.60 downside (two ~60% drawdowns in five years and a -49% drop within 2026 per supervisor), slightly fatter tails at the extremes. 1-month: Q3 print ~Oct 28 inside window; beat likely but Q4 margin guide steps down; centred just below spot.
